entities.summary: Umberto Ortolani was an Italian businessman, banker, farm landowner and media mogul with business interests in Italy and South America. Freemason, a friend of the Cardinal Giacomo Lercaro, since 1963 he was a Papal gentleman and in 1969, he became Ambassador of the Knights Hospitalier Order of Malta in Montevideo.
